movelist.name: Aqua Ring
movelist.effect: Aqua Ring covers the user in a Coat that heals the user at the beginning of their turn. The user is healed a Tick of Hit Points each turn.

movelist.name: Round
movelist.effect: Round’s Damage Base is equal to 6, plus +2 more for each previous use of Round by any Trainer or Pokémon this round, up to a maximum of DB12.

movelist.name: Supersonic
movelist.effect: The target becomes Confused. On miss, the target suffers a -2 penalty to Accuracy Rolls for one full round.

movelist.name: Mud Shot
movelist.effect: The target’s Speed is lowed by -1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Bubble Beam
movelist.effect: Bubble Beam lowers the target’s Speed on 18+.

abilities.name: Mud Dweller
abilities.effect: The user resists Ground-Type and Water-Type attacks one step further.

abilities.name: Poison Touch
abilities.effect: The Pokémon’s Moves which deal damage Poison Legal Targets on 19+. If a move already has a chance of Poisoning foes, Poison Touch increases the effect range by +2.
